title.value: Explainable machine learning model to predict COVID-19 severity among older adults in the province of Quebec
title.justification: The title is directly extracted from the provided paper details.
title.quote: Title: Explainable machine learning model to predict COVID-19 severity among older adults in the province of Quebec

extractions.description: The study aims to evaluate the feasibility of developing explainable machine learning models to predict COVID-19 severity among older adults. The research focuses on using explainable AI methods to assist clinicians in decision-making regarding patient management, particularly in long-term care facilities in Quebec. The paper discusses the application of various machine learning techniques alongside explainable approaches, achieving high performance and alignment with clinical findings.
